say: [remediation-ladder] Fix the cause, not the symptom. A change that skips, masks, retries, or loosens a check until it passes is a band-aid: say why the check fails first. Estimate the real fix honestly before offering a way around it; it is often small. Load the remediation-ladder skill.

pattern: \b(keeps?|kept) (happening|breaking|failing|coming back|doing (this|that|it))\b|\b(happened|broke|failed|did (this|that|it)) again\b|\b(same|this) (mistake|bug|problem|issue|failure|error) (again|keeps)\b|\b(third|second|\d+(st|nd|rd|th)) time\b|\bhow (do|can) we (prevent|stop|avoid)\b|\b(never|doesn't|does not|can't|cannot) happens? again\b|\b(add|write|make) (a |an |this a )?(rule|note|memory|reminder)\b
say: [remediation-ladder] For a problem that recurs, take the highest rung you can: 1) eliminate it, so the mistake cannot be made; 2) automate it, with a hook, guard, or test that needs no one to remember; 3) only then write a rule. Say which rung you chose and why not the one above. Load the remediation-ladder skill.

[remediation-ladder] A lint or complexity gate failed or a suppression is being added. Do not add `# noqa`, raise `max-complexity`, or loosen the lint config—those are band-aids. Fix the structure (extract a helper function or lookup table) so the unmodified gate passes. Load the remediation-ladder skill.

[remediation-ladder] This edit adds a lint suppression, test skip, or loosened check threshold. Remove the suppression and fix the underlying cause structurally so the unmodified gate passes. Load the remediation-ladder skill.

[remediation-ladder] A test failed. Do not wave it off as pre-existing without running it on the base commit (`main`), and do not skip or weaken the test; fix the cause. Load the remediation-ladder skill.
